hypothesis: Existing different real Human parameter scenarios may create action-ranking or original-qualification differences that a fixed nominal phase rule cannot cover

budget.menu: Same frozen traditional/Pareto library and RETURN timing candidates as nominal; each cold parent fully charged, no fixed global simulation cap

success: Actual hidden plant and commissioned state identity differ, unchanged original task/scorer, genuine within-domain candidate benefit or failure differences; full costs/quality audited separately
stop: Case identity/task/options/scorer mismatch, resources/deadline, true safety failure; do not replace failed cases; no learning training unless an actual decision gap is demonstrated
holdout_policy: Do not execute short_segments until main model/traditional proposals and menus frozen; no swapping cases according to results
original_physics: Equations/code/guard unchanged; original registered scenario physical parameters differ and must be reported explicitly
